findings.evidence: `E7/Minuscule/Carrier.lean:24-27` explicitly says reductivity, root-datum identification, and nonsimple root subgroups remain prerequisites before CFSG L0 can use the carrier; this file itself repeats at lines 54-58 and 185-187 that no such identification is proved. The roadmap at `CFSGStatement/README.md:261-294` requires the named pinned Layer 9 carrier and rejects a substitute carrier.
findings.fix: First complete the Layer 9 identification of `E7Minuscule.groupScheme` with the pinned simply connected Chevalley–Demazure group of type E₇, then define or transport `steinberg` and `Group` along that identification.
findings.issue: `steinberg` and the resulting `Group` at line 188 are presented as the E₇(q) constructions, but their ambient `E7Minuscule.points` carrier is not proved to be the pinned simply connected E₇ group; the fixed-point quotient therefore is not yet known to be the E₇ candidate.

summary: The purported E₇ Steinberg map and candidate are constructed on a carrier not yet identified with the required simply connected E₇ group, so the declarations substitute an unfinished prerequisite.
